title: Show the exact offer letter and its delivery forecast at the approval gate
deviations_from_card: (1) useOfferLetterPreview.ts was not created as its own module: the hook is inlined in DecisionsOfferLetterPreview.tsx to hold app/page.tsx to +1 module (page sat exactly at its module ceiling). (2) Write set grew by CandidateDecisionBar.tsx (one prop: entryId={entry.id}) - the card body had no entry id and this is its only mount (card premise cites it at :94). (3) Shared surfaces beyond the card's list, all under the lock and committed alone: app/_lib/api-response.ts (OFFER_LETTER_NOT_PENDING refusal + OFFER_LETTER_PREVIEW_FAILED store code, committed with their 4-locale errors.* keys), perf-budget.json (+1 module, +6 KB for app/page.tsx, measured share only). (4) app/_lib/offer-link-locale.test.ts updated: it pinned pinLinkLocale inside dispatchOffer's body; it now pins the pin inside composeOfferLetter and still forbids an unpinned link in all three bodies. (5) renderCandidateFooters extracted from candidateFooters (pure footer text) and formatOfferDeadline exported, both in comms-dispatch.ts, so the preview shares the send path's wording without minting.
notes: Route: GET /api/pipeline/[id]/offer-letter (requireOperator first, workspace-scoped, 404 PIPELINE_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND, 409 OFFER_LETTER_NOT_PENDING, ttlDays via resolveOfferTtlDays, header declares its contract so api:check's undeclared count is unchanged). comms-letter-preview.ts (imports comms.ts send gate + comms-relay) is imported ONLY by that route, so letter-sending route graphs are unchanged; the page graph gets only DecisionsOfferLetterPreview.tsx (type-only import of the preview). Forecast order mirrors the send path: refused -> simulation -> suppressed -> relay (reason no_contact without a captured address) -> local. unit=1: the only BROKEN file in the full run is app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts ('an aborted spawn kills the whole process tree'), which fails identically when run alone and touches nothing of this card (python subprocess kill on this box); one earlier run also showed an unrelated FLAKE in app/_lib/db/profiles-lineage.test.ts (passes 3/3 alone). perf=1 on the combined tree: app/page.tsx measured 8961 KB on committed HEAD ef27a818c vs ceiling 8948 - this card's measured share (+1 module, +6 KB: 8942 -> 8948 with vs without its UI files on committed HEAD) is already raised in 72dd81720/71114073d; the remaining ~13 KB came from sibling commits landing after that measurement. tsc whole-tree red only on foreign paths (kpi-sim/ untracked tree, sibling's untracked app/_lib/pipeline-arrival-plan.test.ts). The collapsible/live-on-ttlDays UI behaviour has no unit case (tsx cannot be imported in node:test); verified by eslint/tsc/design:check only, not in a browser (dev servers are the operator's).
